cover: Fix the store or change the platform?

slides.title: Product page slow on a phone?
slides.body: Fix it on the platform: a custom theme, fewer apps, and no scripts loading on pages that don't need them.

slides.title: Search fails on a typo?
slides.body: Start with search and filters in the current store. Look further only if platform search misses much of your catalog.

slides.title: Checkout long or demanding?
slides.body: Shorten it on the platform: guest checkout, saved addresses and the wallets customers already have on their phones.

slides.title: A separate store for every market?
slides.body: Headless can serve several locales, currencies and brands from one storefront. That can justify the extra system.

slides.title: Marketing waits on a developer?
slides.body: A headless front end with a content system lets marketing publish landing pages without waiting on a developer.

slides.title: Two people, or six weeks?
slides.body: Keep the platform's front end. Headless adds a codebase, a deploy pipeline and a content system someone has to own.
